estimates.assumptions: Standard slice of white bread is ~30 g; 2 chopped slices used as a test cube for oil temperature totals ~60 g edible portion. Known caloriesPer100g copied exactly.

1 tbsp golden syrup ≈ 21 g (based on typical syrup density of ~1.4 g/ml and 15 ml tbsp); 3 tbsp = 63 g. CaloriesPer100g is a realistic estimate for golden syrup in its recipe-ready state (similar to light corn syrup).
